column1: # Custom 4MB layout for the DEF CON 34 badge.
# A sketch-local partitions.csv overrides the board's PartitionScheme option
# entirely
column2: so this file is the layout regardless of what the FQBN asks for.

column1: # === Code and data are separated on purpose ===
# OTA needs two app slots: the new image lands in the inactive one while the
# badge keeps running from the active one
column2: and otadata records which to boot.

column1: # That rollback is the whole point - without it a bad OTA bricks a badge on
# someone's lanyard with no USB port in sight.
# But images do NOT need to be duplicated across both slots. Baking a 150KB
# bitmap into the firmware means paying for it TWICE (once per slot) and
# re-transmitting every byte of it on every OTA
#   images in the app:   app0 1.94MB + app1 1.94MB
#                        every OTA ships 1.5MB
#   images in storage:   app0 1.5MB + app1 1.5MB + storage 1MB
#                        ~6 images fit
# So: the A/B pair carries CODE ONLY
# are updated independently of firmware
column2: and an OTA is smaller because it never

column1: # re-sends artwork that has not changed.
# Code-only firmware is ~1.24MB
# `storage` is a LittleFS volume; the badge scans it at boot
# .raw in makes it appear in the SHOW menu with no firmware change at all.
# nvs stays at 0x9000/0x5000
# repartitioning does NOT wipe settings or the badge keypair.

nvs
otadata
app0
app1
